frames.conversion_owner: flight-control owns one ENU/FLU to NED/FRD bridge

rate_control.update: Vector3f update(rate, rate_sp, angular_accel, float dt_seconds, bool landed)
rate_control.gains_mapping: P/I/D are MC_{ROLL,PITCH,YAW}RATE_{P,I,D} multiplied componentwise by MC_*RATE_K in the original caller; FF is set separately without K multiplication
rate_control.output: normalized torque; update itself does not clip total torque, original mixer clamps each control input
rate_control.history: owned per controller instance; update returns torque using previous integrator then advances integral; landed suppresses integral update, resetIntegral explicitly zeroes all axes

position_control.resetIntegral: zeros all three velocity integrator axes
position_control.unset: NaN keeps upstream per-axis no-setpoint/no-feedforward semantics; finite XY pairing checked by upstream update
position_control.gravity: original CONSTANTS_ONE_G=9.80665f from pinned ECL geo.h retained

mixer.callback: int(uintptr_t handle, uint8_t group, uint8_t index, float &value); group 0 indices roll=0,pitch=1,yaw=2,thrust=3
mixer.factor: set_thrust_factor(THR_MDL_FAC), applied once inside original mix before [-1,1] scaling
mixer.slew: set_max_delta_out_once(delta_raw) before every mix; mix clears it to zero, motor history starts -1 in constructor
mixer.idle: this exact original MultirotorMixer has no idle setter/member despite stale header comments; downstream output_limit is provenance only, not compiled. Any normalized idle/disarm policy belongs to the explicitly chosen execution boundary
mixer.lifetime: caller retains immutable Rotor array for mixer lifetime

parameters.effective_owner: flight-control four FCU files, one immutable runtime snapshot
parameters.source_of_defaults: raw *_params.c files in source-manifest; no runtime/default table supplied here
parameters.actual_FS150_overrides_owner: flight-control; not inferred from reference tests
parameters.units: official declared units are retained in source comments; gains without @unit use the native math signatures, not guessed Nm conversions

trace_schema.rate_config: P3,I3,D3,integrator_limit3,FF3, all explicit synthetic fixture gains
trace_schema.fixture_only: stress tuning in px4_reference_test.cpp is test stimulus, never runtime defaults

build_tests_option: PX4_REFERENCE_BUILD_TESTS=ON for offline oracle/upstream GTest; default OFF for core consumers

deg in parameters, radians in core
